scripts.check:json: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const file of ['package.json','vercel.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8')); console.log('JSON syntax OK: package.json, vercel.json');"
scripts.check:js: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const cp=require('node:child_process'); const roots=['src','api','scripts']; const files=[]; const walk=(dir)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(dir)) return; for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){const file=path.join(dir,entry.name); if(entry.isDirectory()) walk(file); else if(entry.isFile() && file.endsWith('.js')) files.push(file);}}; roots.forEach(walk); if(!files.length) throw new Error('No JavaScript files found under src, api, or scripts'); files.sort(); for(const file of files){const result=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',file],{stdio:'inherit'}); if(result.status!==0) process.exit(result.status ?? 1);} console.log('JavaScript syntax OK: '+files.length+' files');"
scripts.check:long-root: node -e "Promise.all([import('./src/keys.js'), import('./src/config.js')]).then(([keys,config])=>{const seen=new Set(); const violations=[]; const walk=(value,path)=>{if(typeof value==='string'){if(value.includes('LONG:SHORT:')) violations.push(path+'='+value); return;} if(value===null || (typeof value!=='object' && typeof value!=='function') || seen.has(value)) return; seen.add(value); for(const key of Object.keys(value)){let next; try{next=value[key];}catch{continue;} walk(next,path+'.'+key);}}; walk(keys,'keys'); walk(config,'config'); if(violations.length){console.error('Forbidden LONG:SHORT: exported value found: '+violations.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('LONG exported key/config prefix isolation OK');})"
scripts.check:imports: node -e "Promise.all([import('./src/config.js'), import('./src/redis.js'), import('./src/keys.js'), import('./src/utils.js'), import('./src/lock.js'), import('./src/market/bitgetClient.js'), import('./src/market/indicators.js'), import('./src/market/fakeBreakout.js'), import('./src/market/marketWeather.js'), import('./src/market/scanner.js'), import('./src/trade/costModel.js'), import('./src/trade/positionSizing.js'), import('./src/trade/positionEngine.js'), import('./src/trade/riskEngine.js'), import('./src/trade/tradeSystem.js'), import('./src/analyze/microFamilies.js'), import('./src/analyze/scoring.js'), import('./src/analyze/rotationEngine.js'), import('./src/analyze/analyzeEngine.js'), import('./src/discord/discord.js')]).then(() => console.log('All critical LONG module imports OK'))"
